name: AI Foundations — Little Explorers
description: Awarded for completing and passing the Little Explorers track: an introduction to artificial intelligence for ages 5–12, covering how machines learn from examples, why AI makes mistakes, fairness, and safe use.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 8 lessons and their interactive labs, then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
